title: Pocketrod.app
author: GazJones94
selftext:
Nervous about posting this as some of stuff I see some of you create here is simply incredible.

Embarrassed to say my second most played game on steam is Russian Fishing 4. Over the pandemic I sunk hours and hours into it and I loved the focus on European style fishing rather than bass fishing that every game seems to focus on.

Over the past few weeks ive been using codex on my plus subscription to create Pocketrodd.app a web based mobile focused fishing game where you use your phones gyroscopes to cast and strike whilst reeling with your finger.(Can also use buttons for mobile or desktop)

It's pretty basic/cosy in looks but has some neat mechanics around what baits attract fish, what methods to use and the variety of fishing styles and actions used.

Would love your thoughts on it.

Comment your angler name and I'll give you temporary access to any of the waters you want to try!

Thanks!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/GazJones94 please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with bare game links. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.
